positioning: I am a graduate of the Bachelor of Architecture program, majoring in urbanism, at the Azrieli School of Carleton University. During my studies and in the past few years I have worked in many fields and have amassed plenty of experience. As you scour my portfolio, I hope that my skills and creativity will catch your eye.
longBio: Recent graduate of the Bachelor of Architectural Studies (Honours) program at Carleton University with a major in Urbanism. I combine rigorous academic training with practical, hands-on experience in private residential design, construction, and operations management.

My background, spanning independent architectural projects, construction labour, and leadership roles, has cultivated a pragmatic, design-driven approach that emphasizes functionality, sustainability, and clear communication.
I am eager to contribute to a professional firm where I can apply my technical skills, creativity, and experience to deliver high-quality work and continue growing in the field.
